pages.text: Right-click a trigger block with an empty hand to open its dialog. It shows:

$(li)the PID of the running process$(li)the exit code of the last process, and its error if it crashed$(li)a list to pick the program$(li)a list to pick the function to run$(li)for timer blocks, the interval in ticks

The dialog also has an input inventory, an output inventory and a slot for camouflage. Put any block into that slot, and the trigger block takes on its look.$(br2)The program and function lists are locked while a process runs.
